repos.name: IBM-Bob-osCommerce
repos.description: I used Bob to modernize osCommerce's tangled legacy checkout module. I extracted its core pricing logic and transformed it into a secure, decoupled Node.js REST API with automated test coverage, demonstrating how AI can help modernize mission-critical legacy systems safely and efficiently.

repos.name: spotifyHero
repos.description: Desktop app that turns your Spotify tracks into a Friday Night Funkin' / Guitar Hero-style experience. Auto-generated notes play alongside your screen, jump in anytime via keybind. Includes scoring, leaderboards, and easy sharing to challenge friends on any song.
